canonical_name: Atiyah-Bott fixed point theorem for elliptic complexes
canonical_statement: For an equivariant elliptic complex on a compact manifold and an endomorphism whose fixed set satisfies the fixed-point-formula hypotheses, the Lefschetz number (equivariant index character) equals the sum of the local fixed-set contributions determined by the lifted symbol and the normal action.
domain_and_universes: A compact smooth manifold X with a symmetry/endormorphism f, an f-equivariant elliptic complex E, and coefficient/representation data sufficient to define its Lefschetz number and fixed-set local terms; exact Lean universes and structures remain to be frozen.
quantifiers: endomorphism or group element f acting smoothly on X
f-equivariant elliptic complex E on X
hypotheses: compactness and smoothness assumptions required by the analytic index
an equivariant lift to the complex
the clean/nondegenerate fixed-set conditions required by the selected primary-source formula
invertibility of the normal denominator in the coefficient theory
conclusion: The equivariant Lefschetz number/index character is the sum over fixed-set components of their Atiyah-Bott local contributions.
